how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:midsummer-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9388:obj:0: Visit the bonfires within ⟦E1⟧, the ⟦E2⟧, ⟦E3⟧, and ⟦E4⟧, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
rows.quest:9388:details:0: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, ⟦1⟧. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on ⟦E5⟧ for our Flamekeeper, eh?
rows.quest:9388:details:1: You will find them near Ratchet in the ⟦E2⟧, close to the Master's ⟦E6⟧ in ⟦E3⟧, in the forest of ⟦E1⟧ by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:9388:progress:0: The fires cannot die until the festival is done!
rows.quest:9388:completion:0: Ahhh, so they do still burn. I am glad; it would not do for those fires to burn out before their time. You have done well, ⟦2⟧. Take this with my ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:9389:obj:0: Visit the bonfires within ⟦E8⟧, ⟦E9⟧, ⟦E10⟧, and the ⟦E11⟧, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
rows.quest:9389:details:0: The Midsummer ⟦E12⟧ Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.
rows.quest:9389:details:1: Make sure they still burn in the ⟦E13⟧ for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the ⟦E11⟧, close to Pyrewood Village within ⟦E9⟧, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in ⟦E10⟧, and by the ruined tower in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:9389:progress:0: Have you seen to your task?
rows.quest:9389:completion:0: So you've returned, and you've seen to the emerald flames of the continent. What do you think, mm? A rare and wonderful sight, to be certain. I am aware, however, that tangible rewards are better appreciated... so please, take this for your trouble.
rows.quest:9319:obj:0: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire ⟦E14⟧, ⟦E15⟧, and ⟦E16⟧, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
rows.quest:9319:details:0: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, ⟦3⟧. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.
rows.quest:9319:details:1: If you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within ⟦E16⟧, ⟦E15⟧, among the ogres of Dire ⟦E14⟧, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
rows.quest:9319:progress:0: Have you found your way through the dark?
rows.quest:9319:completion:0: You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

rows.quest:9322:details:0: The Midsummer ⟦E12⟧ Festival is celebrated everywhere in ⟦E21⟧, and the diverse land of ⟦E5⟧ is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.
rows.quest:9322:details:1: Midsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western ⟦E20⟧, northeastern ⟦E17⟧, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of ⟦E18⟧, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
rows.quest:9322:progress:0: Are the flames of ⟦E5⟧ burning brightly?
rows.quest:9322:completion:0: Your spirit glows with the warmth of the ⟦E5⟧ fires, friend. Is the heat not invigorating? Once the power fades from you, perhaps these will help rekindle the feeling.
rows.quest:9323:obj:0: Visit the ⟦E12⟧ Festival camps located in ⟦E22⟧, ⟦E23⟧, the Hinterlands and ⟦E24⟧, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
rows.quest:9323:details:0: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, ⟦4⟧. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.
rows.quest:9323:details:1: You'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the ⟦E23⟧ near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the ⟦E22⟧.

rows.quest:9323:progress:0: It will take time to prevail against this ⟦E25⟧. How have you fared, ⟦5⟧?
rows.quest:9323:completion:0: Ah, here you are. A little wearier, a bit dustier, but enlightened! The heat touches us all during this season and unites us; your very being glows with the power of the fires you touched. Ah, but these days enlightenment is taken as a rather poor reward for being sent on a task, I suppose. Take these, then, and enjoy the celebration.
rows.quest:9324:obj:0: Return the ⟦E26⟧ to the Festival Loremaster.
rows.quest:9324:details:0: This flame, stolen from the heart of ⟦E27⟧ itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
rows.quest:9324:progress:0: You're practically glowing, ⟦6⟧. What do you have there?
rows.quest:9324:completion:0: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of ⟦E27⟧ itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the ⟦E28⟧'s lair to retrieve the sacred flame!
